thread:
Hana G: Quick design flag from review session: reviewers keep typing the same short reasons when approving prompt cases. Can we provide inline canned reasons and let people edit them?
Omar S: Agree. It'd speed up approvals and standardize analytics. Do we need templating?
Lina Q: Two proposed flows: (A) small dropdown of 5 suggested reasons (editable after selection), (B) autofill with ML-suggested reason that the user can accept or edit.
Ben R: Backend: we store freeform comments today. Adding a reason_id field to approval payload would be straightforward. ML suggestions need an endpoint and opt-in flag.
Hana G: Accessibility: suggestions must be keyboard navigable and announced when focused. a11y-bot: keep aria-activedescendant for the listbox and announce selection.
a11y-bot: Also make sure edited text still announces changes; avoid inline live region spam.
Lina Q: Copy for dropdown items (short): "Works as intended", "Output incomplete", "Off-topic", "Policy issue", "Formatting error". Allow custom text.
Omar S: UX: show a tiny chip with the reason in the scorecard row once applied; clicking it opens the edit menu. Also include a filter by reason in runs list.
Ben R: Action items: 1) Add reason_id + reason_text to approval API. 2) Feature-flag ML suggestions. 3) Frontend: dropdown + editable textarea + chip display.
Hana G: I'll draft microcopy variants and mock the dropdown. Lina will prototype the ML accept/edit flow. Omar will scope analytics tagging. a11y-bot please post ARIA checklist.
Lina Q: Will drop frames in #design today :paintbrush: 
Hana G: Thanks — aiming to include this in next sprint if infra effort is small.
